intro: Turn agents on or off, choose how capable a model each uses, and set what each may spend in a day. Changes reach the agents within a minute, without a restart.

sum.budget: Their daily budgets total {{tokens}} tokens and {{turns}} turns.
sum.models: Strong uses Claude Opus, Standard uses Sonnet and Routine uses Haiku. Stronger models think better and use more of your Claude plan.

offNote: Off. These settings apply when you turn {{name}} on.
over: Used today: {{v}}. That is already over this budget, so {{name}} would stop until midnight Baghdad time.

err.range: {{label}} must be a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

webIntro: These lists apply to every page Market Scout or News Intelligence opens, and to the web searches they run.
allowNote: Only sites on this list can be opened or searched. Add a site to allow it.
allowEmpty: No sites allowed: page fetches and web search are off.
denyNote: A blocked site always wins, and so do its subdomains.
place: Add a site, such as coindesk.com
savedBody: The agents pick up the change within a minute.
failedBody: Atlas’s server didn’t answer, so nothing changed. Try again.
invalid: The server refused a field. Fix it and save again.

merged.title: Version {{v}} came from another window
merged.body: Your changes are still here, on top of it. Check them, then save.

activityNote: Every change is a new settings version. The agents always read the newest one.
activityEmpty: No agent settings have changed yet.

error.title: Couldn’t load the agent settings
error.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Check that Atlas is running with ./atlas up, then try again.
